snippet.title: Defender of the Crown: The Legend Returns - Launch Trailer | PS5 Games
snippet.description:

👑 Celebrate 40 years of Defender of the Crown with the return of the legendary medieval strategy adventure!

Conquer territories, raise armies, storm castles, shape the balance of power, and unite the kingdom under your banner. ⚔️🛡️🏰

👑 Defender of the Crown: The Legend Returns is OUT NOW! 👑
